initiative.subject: Sprint Velocity Calculator — a CLI tool that reads sprint history from a JSON file (sprints with completed/planned story points), calculates average velocity, standard deviation, confidence intervals (P50/P80/P90), trend analysis, and forecasts the next sprint range. Simple TypeScript CLI, no external runtime deps, JSON file storage.
initiative.context: Sprint velocity forecasting CLI tool — TypeScript, JSON storage, percentile-based prediction
